entries.summary: AIP-137 ws-hub-migration §1+§3: the hub's raw-hex Tailwind @theme mirror is replaced by the design system's role tokens; six value shifts follow from role convergence.
entries.rationale: Convergence onto the canonical token source (ADR-213) — the mirror was the parallel token system the decision kills. Role-mapped shifts, old → new: (1) page/surface background #f4f3ef → #ffffff (bg.primary); (2) hairline borders #e0ded6 → #cacaca (border.neutral-lighter); (3) notice tint #fffdf0 → #fff7cc (color.accent-subtle); (4) amber fills #ff934e → #ffc8a6 (surface.decorative-6); (5) mid-grey borders #575757 → #808080 (border.neutral); (6) ink shadow 2px 2px 0 #222222 → 0.063rem 0.125rem 0 #000000 (shadow.ink). All other mapped tokens are hex-identical (verified against the Stage-A report's resolved-role table); signature shadows/radii are value-identical with rem units replacing px (scales with root font size — an access improvement, not a divergence). Do not re-flag on export re-ingest.
entries.author: Salmon binds Undertow (de5c10)

entries.summary: AIP-137 ws-hub-migration §4+§5: pre-paint theme/motion bootstrap, five-theme + motion controls in a footer display-settings band, and the kit's double focus ring replacing the single navy ring.
entries.rationale: Kit integration doc §4 (theme + motion wiring: oak-theme.js inlined pre-paint from the workspace package; data-motion axis semantics on the hub's motion floor — OS default, explicit choice wins both directions) and §5 (focus): the single navy :focus-visible ring is upgraded to the kit's double ring (lemon + contrast halo + transparent outline for forced-colors) — the doc names this an upgrade, not a divergence. Divergence from the doc recorded: the kit scopes rings to .oak-* classes, so the hub keeps a GLOBAL rule carrying the kit recipe until §6 migrates controls onto kit classes (deleting the global rule now would strand unmigrated controls on UA-default focus). The footer display-settings band is a new feature surface (theme choice did not exist in the canonical export). Staged-migration note: dark/system exposure precedes the full component polarity migration — residual fixed-polarity colours (e.g. hard bg-white on cards) are §6's scope, tracked in the design-system-integration plan; the review-round cures (footer, standards rail, framework control) shrank the residual set. Do not re-flag on export re-ingest.

entries.summary: The tabs example callout moves from the decorative mint (50 tint) to the functional success fill (30 tint) with the functional success border, and its label goes text-ink per the kit's text-on-pastel-fills contract — decorative surfaces are contractually non-semantic.
entries.rationale: Kit token contract (colors_and_type.css): decorative surfaces carry categorisation only, never meaning; functional fills exist so re-branding decoratives never moves semantics. The positive-example callout is a semantic success state, so it consumes bg-success-subtle with the --border-success border role (utility border-line-success), and the label text is --text-primary per the kit contract (tone text on the subtle fills fails 4.5:1 in light/colour-safe — design-system-expert computed). Same hue family, lighter tint — visible in the section capture; do not re-flag.
entries.author: Zenith binds Plasma (8fa90f)

entries.summary: The correct-answer wash moves from the decorative mint (50 tint) to the functional success fill (30 tint) with the functional success border, and the ✓/✕ chips move from saturated text-role fills with white marks to the subtle fills with ink marks — the answer states are semantic.
entries.rationale: Kit token contract (colors_and_type.css): a correct quiz answer is meaning, not categorisation, so it consumes bg-success-subtle with the --border-success border role (utility border-line-success) rather than the decorative mint ramp; the chips drop the text-role-as-fill misuse (bg-success/bg-error are text-polarity aliases) for the same subtle fills with --text-primary marks per the kit's text-on-pastel-fills contract. Colour-safe and theme overrides then stay aligned with the state; do not re-flag.
entries.author: Zenith binds Plasma (8fa90f)

entries.summary: The compare block's good/bad headers move from saturated text-role fills with white text (bg-success/bg-error + text-white) to the functional subtle fills with ink text, per the kit's functional-fill and text-on-pastel-fills contracts.
entries.rationale: bg-success/bg-error alias the kit's TEXT-polarity roles (--text-success/--text-error) — used as fills they break polarity in dark theme (light text-role fill under white text). The functional meaning-bearing recipe is bg-success-subtle/bg-error-subtle with --text-primary on the pastel fill (kit components.css contract line; tone carried by fill + border + wording). Visible in the section capture as a lighter header with dark text; do not re-flag.
